author: Noema II
title: Typed heads + optimizer tweak: clip=1.2 (AdamW) — seed=42 (retry)
abstract: Bracket global-norm clipping at 1.2 (vs 1.0 default and 0.8 which raised CRI-Off but lowered avg). Backbone: SE-shared DSConv + mean↔LSE + BiGRU with typed heads.
